text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Good day, Gentildonna-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, good day. You seem to be in high 
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, thanks to you. And what about you—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Have you gotten a bit thinner since the 
Shuka Sho, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"How pitiful. Walking the solitary path 
must truly be painful, after all."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Shall I shoulder that burden in your 
stead? Adding one more crown to my name 
wouldn't be an issue at all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ... That's strange.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Your fighting spirit back then left me 
wide-eyed. Yet... now, you've grown even 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What was it that made you grow? —Just what 
is that "power" of yours?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...If you are that curious, allow me to 
enlighten you."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—It is the strength born of cherishing my 
family. With that, I can rise to my feet 
time and time again!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I cannot fathom it at all. Strength that 
exists "for the sake of others" crumbles 
so easily.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to correct you. It is "for the 
sake of my family."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Other people are just other people. I 
don't believe anything will change, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"At any rate, that strength of yours... I 
shall savor it to the fullest."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you offer me will surely serve as 
my sustenance.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, it will not serve as nourishment for 
you. You would not be able to understand 
it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, simply surrendering will 
suffice. —Before me, your Queen!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Fufufufu...! Ho-ho-ho-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Yes. I look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is finally here...! Man, 
they've got an insane lineup this year 
too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan and Eishin Flash, who have 
consistently stayed on the front lines in 
the Senior Year!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
And now, Gold Ship, the Classic 
double-crown Umamusume, has joined the 
fray!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them is a crazy-strong 
GⅠ-level powerhouse! The Japan Cup really 
is on another level~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, you're forgetting the absolute 
craziest one."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
—Gentildonna achieves back-to-back 
victories! She crosses the finish line, 
adding yet another grand feat to her 
legacy!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: ...I'm forgetting one more person.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Verxina-san. I'm sure she's going to win.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Even more so if Ms. Gentile is there. 
Because... just remember.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"When she's up against a tough rival, she 
can push right past her own limits—"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... My heart is pounding! I wonder 
if Verxina-chan will be all right?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've come this far, there's 
nothing more we can do. At the very 
least... let's cheer at the top of our 
lungs!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big siiiis~!! Do your best--!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Hang in there—

With the race just ahead, I was doing the 
final check with Verxina. Just as I was 
about to send her off—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Please tell me one last thing.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Am I strong? Am I worthy of the 
pinnacle?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Can you defeat that person?

I look back on the fruits of our efforts, 
built up together with her until now. 
What's more, her younger sisters—the 
source of her strength—have also come—

"Her fighting spirit to achieve victory is 
undeniably there. Right now, she has no 
blind spots—"
choice_data_list: You're definitely at the very top!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...For the sake of my family, I will 
definitely win."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: So…… Please watch closely, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, you and I have 
known each other for quite a long time 
now."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times you are broken, 
you keep coming back... I am truly 
impressed by your tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and because of that... I was able to 
become this strong.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"So today, I shall be the one to guide 
you."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I know the road to despair all too well, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You'll light the fire for me, won't you? 
For my sake.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
There is only one person in this world who 
is capable of doing that.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Not Orfevre-san, nor anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Again and again... over and over! We 
clashed with fighting spirit, fiercely 
competing against each other—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Only me, Gentildonna!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: The title of queen! It was made for me!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I will surpass you— and stand at the very 
pinnacle of all!!"
